# Eilanden van Hain - Fase 1B (projectwebsite)

> Static project website for AM development project "Eilanden van Hain - Fase 1B"
> (PIM project id 1409, Krommenie, NL), generated from a snapshot of the AM PIM.

## Pages
- /            — project overview: key facts, description, photo gallery, house types, location map, brochures/documents
- /aanbod/     — full offer: all 32 units (bouwnummer) grouped by house type, with price, status, surface, rooms, energy label, floorplan links; filterable/sortable in the browser
- /404         — not-found page

## Machine-readable data (public, no auth)
- /pim/snapshot.json — the full PIM snapshot (project, housetypes with nested houses, flat house list) used to build this site. Plain JSON.
- JSON-LD (schema.org) embedded in every page:
  - /         — RealEstateListing for the project (geo, price range, availability) + ItemList of house types
  - /aanbod/  — ItemList of all units (sku = bouwnummer, Offer with price/availability, floorplan url)
- /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt are served from the root.

## Data source & freshness
- Source of truth is the AM PIM (Property Information Management). This site is a static snapshot of PIM project 1409; maintainers refresh it with the repository's fetch/build pipeline (see README). No credentials or internal endpoints are published on this site — /pim/snapshot.json is the public read-only view.
- All prices are EUR, sale condition v.o.n. ("vrij op naam"). Status values are Dutch ("Te Koop", "Optie", "Verkocht") and are mapped to schema.org availability in the JSON-LD (InStock / LimitedAvailability / SoldOut).
- Images and documents are served from the public PIM CDN (pim-cdn.nieuwbouwdossier.nl).
